name: In Service of Zephras

faq.answer: Valennia Stormfist leads the peacekeepers responsible for protecting Zephras. She coordinates the defense of the island, including Valanaar's campaign against the hostile cult known as the Al'Aketh.

The Windshapers are an allied group on Zephras who assist Valennia Stormfist and her peacekeepers. They offer their complete backing to Valanaar's forces in combating the rising threat of the Al'Aketh.
The Al'Aketh are a cult operating across the island of Zephras. Reports indicate they are conducting larger-scale movements and preparing for imminent conflict.
Zephras is an island defended by Valennia Stormfist and her peacekeepers, where the Windshapers provide aid against threatening cult activity from the Al'Aketh.
Valanaar is a settlement on Zephras, home to Valennia Stormfist's peacekeepers. Its fight against the Al'Aketh has the Windshapers' full support.

sections.body: Tensions are escalating across the island of Zephras as reports indicate widespread cult activity. The peacekeepers under Valennia Stormfist have long stood guard over these lands, but the Al'Aketh appear to be organizing for a larger conflict. To ensure the island remains protected, the Windshapers have pledged to stand firmly alongside Valanaar's forces should active hostilities erupt.
sections.title: Rumors on the Island

sections.body: You are dispatched to meet with Valennia Stormfist and confirm that the Windshapers stand fully prepared to aid her peacekeepers. Upon hearing of this allied readiness, Valennia welcomes the swift commitment and prepares to discuss the worsening situation regarding the cult.
sections.title: Pledging Support

summary: Word spreads across Zephras that the Al'Aketh cult is mobilizing for a significant conflict. To bolster the island's defenses, an emissary is sent to reassure Valennia Stormfist that the Windshapers stand ready to support her peacekeepers.
attribution: In-game quest text: In Service of Zephras
